hints.title: Two Strategy Choices
hints.text: Alice can choose either all single-digit numbers or all double-digit numbers. Bob receives all remaining numbers.

hints.title: Strict Majority Requirement
hints.text: For Alice to win, her chosen sum must be strictly greater than Bob's remaining sum.

hints.title: Equality Condition
hints.text: Because the sum of single digits plus double digits equals the total array sum, Alice wins if and only if the single digit sum does not equal the double digit sum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def canAliceWin(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        single_sum = sum(x for x in nums if x < 10)
        double_sum = sum(x for x in nums if x >= 10)
        return single_sum != double_sum
```

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating single and double digit sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force partition searches are unnecessary for this two-choice game.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that Alice wins whenever single digit sum and double digit sum are not identical.
